domain: All d,k in N, W in R^(kxd), b in R^k, x in R^d
quantifier: For every admissible parameter tuple and every pair x,x'
predicate: F is the explicit Euler step for -grad g and ||F(x)-F(x')||_2 <= ||x-x'||_2
failure_condition: Any admissible activation segment with Jacobian operator norm greater than one
